title: Molten vaults: your four leads refined (608 D1b2, D1b3, D1b5, D1b6)
desc: J circled 608 D1b2 hex, D1b3 tall, D1b5 caged, D1b6 squat: "Refine the four", 3 variations each. Drip colour "be creative, change it up": each take names its drips (gold, bright green light, gold cooling to green, dark emerald with gold flecks, milky jade).

takes.name: Hex: onion dome
takes.facts: drips: bright green light. Hex with an onion dome: the roof swells out, then narrows to a finial; green light leaks down as the drips; 2,350 boxes

takes.name: Hex: lancet arches
takes.facts: drips: gold cooling to green. Hex with a gold lancet arch over each panel and a double belt; the drips run gold and cool to green; 2,288 boxes

takes.name: Hex: flared skirt
takes.facts: drips: dark emerald with gold flecks. Hex on a wide flared skirt with buttress fins between the back pillars; dark emerald drips with gold flecks; 2,195 boxes

takes.name: Tall: belted
takes.facts: drips: milky jade with a soft glow. Tall vault split by a wide engraved gold belt at mid height, a taller spiked crown; milky jade drips; 1,134 boxes

takes.name: Tall: spire
takes.facts: drips: bright green light. Tall vault under a stepped spire that narrows to a point; bright green light leaking down as drips; 1,093 boxes

takes.name: Tall: twin chamber
takes.facts: drips: polished gold. Two stacked glass chambers in one tall vault, a gold floor between them, a spiked crown; polished gold drips; 1,116 boxes

takes.name: Caged: lattice
takes.facts: drips: gold cooling to green. The cage as a diagonal lattice of gold bars crossing a pixel off the glass; drips cool from gold to green; 1,634 boxes

takes.name: Caged: domed
takes.facts: drips: bright green light. Cage bars that carry on up and arch over the roof to meet at a crown ring; green light drips; 1,359 boxes

takes.name: Caged: heavy bars
takes.facts: drips: dark emerald with gold flecks. A heavier cage: thick square bars with rivets at every crossing of two cage belts; dark emerald drips, gold flecks; 1,134 boxes

takes.name: Squat: claw feet
takes.facts: drips: polished gold. Squat vault on four curled claw feet; polished gold drips; 1,302 boxes

takes.name: Squat: pagoda
takes.facts: drips: gold cooling to green. Squat pagoda: two stacked dripping eaves roofs with a short glass drum between; drips cool from gold to green; 1,128 boxes

takes.name: Squat: fringe
takes.facts: drips: milky jade with a soft glow. Squat vault with wide flat eaves hung with a fringe of beaded drips all round, short feet; milky jade drips; 1,259 boxes
